purpose: Eight static-grip motion timing proposals for sword-and-shield first-person assemblies; no Blender edits or motion generation performed.

evidence.timing_source: Reported event times supplied by the coordinating task; this subtask did not inspect the video.
source_inputs_missing_for_this_subtask: Explicit current Blender/GLB source paths and controller/pivot identifiers
evidence.limitation: All translations, rotations, run cadence and jump phase boundaries below are inferred proposals, not measurements from the video.

coordinate_system.rotation_convention: Active right-handed extrinsic XYZ rotations around fixed camera-local axes; with column vectors use R = Rz(z) * Ry(y) * Rx(x). These are deltas from the approved ready pose, not absolute model Euler angles.
coordinate_system.application: The parent task chooses the actual controller pivot. Apply the rotation delta about that pivot, then camera-local translation. Move each complete hand/weapon assembly together; do not scale, bend, or change grip geometry.
coordinate_system.camera_motion: No camera motion or character root locomotion is defined.

interpolation.fast_crossings: Keep keys within the reported crossing windows. Prefer near-linear velocity through the central crossing; soften only entry/exit. Do not stretch attack contact windows to fit recovery.
interpolation.angles: Unwrap each Euler component to the shortest intended continuous track before interpolation; adapt to actual controller orientation.
interpolation.root_adaptation: These values are a bounded starting proposal. Parent must inspect actual projected silhouette, resolve sword/shield overlap, and adjust pivot/amplitudes before delivery.

jump_split.basis: Only the overall lower→raise→land-compress→recover sequence and full window were supplied. Internal takeoff/air/land divisions are inferred.
